newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-Gibbs ton helps S.Africa to 247-4 at tea v India A.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Gibbs ton helps S.Africa to 247-4 at tea v India A.

text.p: A brilliant unbeaten century by Herschelle Gibbs helped South Africa post 247 for the loss of four wickets at tea on Tuesday, the first day of a three-day match against an Indian selection.
At tea, he was batting on 117 having hit one huge six and 15 boundaries. The other not out batsman was Derek Crookes on 36.
The Indian bowlers on view were unimpressive with the exception of paceman D. Ganesh.

In a fiery spell in the second session, the promising paceman, from the southern Karnataka state, grabbed two wickets in three balls getting both Daryll Cullinan and Brian McMillan to edge catches to the wicket-keeper.
Scores: South Africa 247-4 at tea (Cronje 53, Gibbs not out 117, Crookes not out 36. Ganesh 2-39).
